mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3 years is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a sharp contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 4 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing supply shock regime (INDPRO growth below 0.5% annually), reduced industrial production lowers corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO yoy growth is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 5 years is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,100,000 units annually, it signals strong consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1100.0, or Rank IC over 3 years is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a tightening monetary policy coinciding with labor market weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 4 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle demand regime (GDPC1 quarterly growth below 2.0% annually), slowing economic expansion reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annualized qoq growth is below 2.0%, or Rank IC over 5 years is negative.
